title: Unique Umami Chinese Shrimp Flatbread
description: Savory Chinese dish featuring naan bread, tempering chocolate, and shrimp, perfect for a pescatarian friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30 second increments, stirring between each interval.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium high heat and cook the shrimp until pink and fully cooked.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Brush the naan bread with the soy sauce mixture and top with cooked shrimp, scallions, and ginger.
Drizzle the melted tempering chocolate over the top of the flatbread.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes, or until the chocolate is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
